title: Report
intro: Animal cruelty is a crime in Brazil (Law 9,605/98). Report it here and also use the official channels.
flagrant: Is it happening right now? Call 190 immediately.
accountBody: To report through the app and follow up, create an account. The official channels below work without one.

hub.title: Make a report
hub.body: Describe what happened, where, and send photos if you can. Only you can see your report.

channels.title: Official channels
channels.intro: For the police to investigate, also report through an official channel:
channels.online: You can also file a police report through your state's online police station, or go to the nearest station.
channels.law: Law 9,605/98, art. 32: animal cruelty is a crime. For dogs and cats, Law 14,064/2020 sets 2 to 5 years in prison.

mine.title: My reports
mine.empty: You haven't made any report through the app yet.

types.confinement: Chained or confined in an unsuitable place

statusHelp.received: Your report is recorded and will be reviewed by the moderation team.
statusHelp.forwarded: The report was forwarded to a responsible agency.

form.title: New report
form.flagrant: If it's happening now, call 190 before filling this in.
form.descriptionHint: When, how often, how the animal is. The more details, the better.
form.locationHelp: Required: where it happened. It stays in your report only, it's not public.
form.suspectHint: Only what you saw (e.g. resident of the blue house). You don't need the name.
form.anonymousHint: Your name and contact won't be sent to whoever receives the referral.
form.goodFaith: Report in good faith. Falsely accusing someone of a crime is also a crime.

sent.title: Report sent
sent.body: Thank you for protecting animals. You can follow up here.
